look_here_first: Rub the leaf and inspect the bud: slippery elm has a thick, sandpaper-rough leaf plus reddish bud scales with red/tawny hairs; the inner bark is mucilaginous, but bark damage is not required for field ID.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: deciduous elm of rich streambanks and moist slopes near the western edge of its Texas range

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: leaves large, thick, strongly asymmetric and double-serrate

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: bud scales reddish with red-tomentose margins

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: spring samara relatively large; margin not ciliate, body characteristically pubescent

key_traits.label: Elm training
key_traits.text: Read leaf texture/asymmetry together with twig wings, bark, reproductive season and samara characters.
